candidate.answerReason: Under the recorded model of upright objects on common level ground with common parallel sun rays, height-to-shadow ratios are equal. Thus \(h=5(3/2)=7.5\text{ m}\).

methods.label: Height-to-shadow proportion
methods.explanation: Sunlight produces parallel projection, so object height is proportional to shadow length: \(3/2=h/5\), giving \(h=7.5\).
methods.levelReason: Parallel sunlight, similar triangles, and solving a proportion are within Grade 9 scope.
